content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IIT Mandi Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download IIT Mandi Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Sports Coach (Basketball)- Male: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Physical Education, Certificate Course in Coaching from a recognised institution, NIS Diploma in the relevant sport. Experience: Representation at State / University / National level preferred. content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 25 Years Maximum Age: 50 Years Age Relaxation: Relaxation in age and qualification may be granted to candidates who have represented National / Senior National level, or possess other notable achievements or qualifications in sports coaching.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Mandi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Mandi (IIT Mandi) for hiring temporary coaching staff.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Mandi?
faq.answer: IIT Mandi has advertised openings for the post of Part Time Coach, specifically covering Basketball (Male) and Squash disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Part Time Coach positions across Basketball and Squash sports disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for IIT Mandi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is via a Google Form submission followed by a direct Walk-in-Selection process at the designated campus venue.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the online form for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their required Google Form application latest by 08 October 2026 before attending the scheduled walk-in selection.

faq.question: Q6. When is the walk-in selection process scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in selection process is scheduled to be held on 10 October 2026 starting at 09:30 A.M. at the institute premises.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants applying for these coaching roles?
faq.answer: Applicants must generally fall within the age bracket of 25 Years to 50 Years, subject to relaxations for exceptional sports achievements.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for the Part Time Coach posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging between ₹ 28,000/- and ₹ 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates require a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Physical Education, a Certificate Course in Coaching, or an NIS Diploma in the relevant sport.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in selection process be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in selection process will be conducted at M1- Sports Complex, South Campus, IIT Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, Pincode 175075.
